hypothesis: The triple-window leader uses one factor family in all sleeves. Preregistered cross-sleeve factor combinations may reduce correlated errors across the early, middle, and late windows while retaining the successful joint daily gate.
version_contract: one hundred fixed Latin-style early-middle-late factor-family combinations on windows 2-23, 23-47, and 47-77; each version ranks five development thresholds and two causal volatility targets
